data.name: Adopt Me Donation Paddle with Rescue Pup
data.headline: Donated 45 min Paddle & Photo Shoot
data.description:
#SUP Pups loves helping the pups in need, but we also need your help too!



SUP PUPS loves helping the pups in Need! Are you fostering a dog that is up for adoption and want help sharing their story?? Give them an adventure of a life time by bringing them to SUP Pups for a complimentary 45 minute SUP Pups lesson with your foster where we can capture videos and photos of them while sharing their story in hopes of finding their forever home!

If you wanted to bring a friend along they are more than welcome to come! Please reach out to Samantha of SUP Pups and you can rent a board for your friend to tag along too! 

623-696-7008

meeting_point.address: 2592 Laning Road San Diego, CA US 92106

data.cancellation_notes:
Customers will receive a full refund or the option to reschedule with at least 24 hours notice prior to their scheduled booking.

Cancellations made within 24 hours of the scheduled start time are non refundable.

We understand that life happens. If something comes up within the 24 hour window, please communicate directly with Samantha, the owner. We will always do our best to work with you when possible, as the health, safety, and happiness of both humans and dogs is our top priority.

In the event that SUP Pups must cancel due to unsafe weather or unforeseen circumstances, customers will receive the option to reschedule or receive a full refund.

No shows will be charged the full booking amount.

**To cancel or make changes to your reservation, please contact us directly at 623-696-7008**
data.booking_notes:
##Let's get ready to SUP! 
Thank you for coming out on the water with SUP Pups! I can't wait to get out on the water with you. Please make sure to fill out liability waiver form in this email so we can have more time paddling when you arrive! 

Please Arrive at least 10 minutes prior to your reservation to say hello, get suited up, put things away before we start the land demo! 

Then from the land demo we move down to the sandy beach where we will depart into the waterway behind Liberty Station that is a no-wake zone and ends in a dead end. 

###Please be very cautious of the surrounding rocks around the entire waterway that has SHARP oysters that will cut your feet/paws. 

If your dog is on a leash and you stay within the designated beach zone then you will be 1000% fine :) 


All photos and videos are included in your experience with us :) 


Restrooms are located in NTC park at the salmon colored building just north of our set up or inside the Courtyard Marriott Hotel. Back entrance to the hotel is only open to the public in the morning. 



##Location and Parking 

From Rosecrans street you will turn onto Farragut St. 
Farragut ends in a cul-de-sac. 
You will see a grass park to your left and a hotel entrance to your right. 

All is Free Parking in Liberty Station

- Street parking on Farragut or Cushing
- NTC Park parking lot 
- Cul-de-sac
- Side parking lot of Courtyard Marriott Hotel where our POD Containers are and you will see the SUP Pups Van. 
- Last resort you can park in front of the hotel and then walk to the back. 

###Walk East towards the water and you will look for Yellow SUP Pups tent next to sister company West Coast Paddle Sports Rentals 

Below is a visual to help! :) 

![Description of image](https://cdn.filestackcontent.com/pcY9FGJRRea4mwy1tELp)


Please feel free to call or text Sam for any questions 623-696-7008

###Dogs must be on a leash at ALL times 

#What to Bring

- Towel
- Dog treats
- Flat leash for your dog if paddle boarding. (no retractable leashes please)
- Dog life jacket if you have one, if not one will be provided
- Your Smile :)
